newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends firm as 3rd mth breaks resistance.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends firm as 3rd mth breaks resistance.

text.p: Palm oil prices ended at around the day's best levels on strong short-covering, technical and speculative buying after the benchmark July futures broke the (1,280 ringgit) resistance level.
Trading was volatile with more activity seen in late dealings, traders said.

"Active speculative buying and short-covering emerged after July futures broke the resistance of 1,280 ringgit," a trader said. "Technical buying continued in late dealing and pushed July futures to close at the day's best level of 1,284 ringgit ($510.84) a tonne." The contract was 14 ringgit higher.
